Enterprise SIP RFC 3911 Join Anti-Wiretap & RFC 3891 Replaces early-only Call-Pickup Guard
企业 SIP RFC 3911 Join 非授权强插窃听拦截、[1,2] 路督导混音锁与 RFC 3891 Replaces early-only 防劫持门禁（🎉 881 护栏、890 合成探针与 700 现场探针三重里程碑）
1. SIP RFC 3911 Join Anti-Wiretap & RBAC Gate (P871)
• 痛点：越权分机或跨租户发送 INVITE + Join: 头静默并入混音桥窃听 VIP 通话
• 督导门禁：强制同租户 Supervisor RBAC 签名核验，并将督导流限制在 [1, 2] 路
❌ Attack: Unauthenticated INVITE Join: call-123 | 12 concurrent barge legs
✅ P871 Gate: Same-Tenant Supervisor RBAC (SIP 403) + [1, 2] Barge Streams
Action: reject_unauthorized_join_with_403_and_enforce_supervisor_rbac
确定性收敛指标（P871）：
✔ clampedUnauthorizedJoinWiretapAttempts = 0（0 未授权静默强插窃听）
✔ clampedMaxAuthorizedSupervisorBargeStreams ∈ [1, 2]（单通话并发督导流上限）
2. SIP RFC 3891 Replaces Anti-Hijack & Entropy Gate (P872)
• 痛点：代接漏带 early-only 强行顶替已接通 (Confirmed) 通话，或盲猜 32-bit 短 Tag
• 防抢接锁：代接强制 early-only 校验并将 Dialog Tag 熵值锁在 [128, 256] bits
❌ Hijack: Pickup without early-only on Confirmed call | 32-bit weak tag
✅ P872 Gate: Mandatory early-only Lock (SIP 481/486) + [128, 256]-Bit Tag
Action: reject_hijacked_replaces_with_481_and_enforce_128bit_tag_entropy
确定性收敛指标（P872）：
✔ clampedHijackedReplacesDialogAttempts = 0（0 已接通会话被抢接劫持）
✔ clampedDialogTagCryptographicEntropyBits ∈ [128, 256] bits（高熵防猜 Tag）
